snippet.title: WRETCHED DEPTHS by Wretched Devs LLC Full Play (NO Commentary PSX Horror Fishing Project by Students
snippet.description:
WRETCHED DEPTHS by Wretched Devs LLC 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343240/Wretched_Depths/
https://wretcheddevsstudios.itch.io/wretched-depths

Sam, an avid fishing fan, has traveled to the remote Twin Pines to cast into the mysterious Lake Imperium. However as she begins to adjust to her surroundings. Odd and unexplainable events begin to occur left and right in a town where  the people seem strange, and the fish even stranger.

Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell the fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore deeper into the depths of the mysterious lake. But, be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom of Lake Imperium. Do you really want to find out what lurks below...?

Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror fishing game created by students in the University of Utah's Entertainment Arts & Engineering capstone class.
